messages.content: Write a bounded test program, not a report. Return exactly one JSON object with the single key source and a string value containing JavaScript. No markdown. Generate 2 to 4 separate statements: one baseline and other independent single-fault experiments you select from the provided operator registry for ambiguous payment outcomes. Each statement must be await ghost.run({faults:[],amount:12500}); or the same call with EXACTLY ONE fault object {operator,point,magnitude}. Do not combine faults or copy the whole registry into one call. Use each operator's exact id and point. Magnitude is an integer 1..5000; use 1 unless latency calls for more. Put SINGLE QUOTES around JavaScript string values so they need no escaping inside the outer JSON string. Never put literal backslashes before JavaScript quotes. Only JSON-style string/number/object/array literals are allowed. No imports, variables, functions, loops, computed properties, assertions, filesystem, process, network or other calls. The host verifies invariants independently; do not return verdicts.
